d:
Celebrate World Vegan Day with 4 delicious recipes that are completely free from meat, eggs and dairy! Whether you're exploring vegan food or simply looking to try something new, these recipes bring together amazing flavours, textures and variety without compromising on taste.
Enjoy a creamy Vegan Pumpkin Soup, a protein-packed Vegan Tofu Omelette, rich and comforting Vegan Dal Makhani and finish with delicious Vegan Malai Peda made with cashews, almonds, dates and tofu.
From savoury favourites to a sweet treat, discover how delicious and exciting vegan cooking can be!
